reminder.notes:
Reminder 2.25.1 - Diagnostics finally have somewhere to go

The app has recorded technical failures for a long time and has never once been
able to send them. They were posted to a Tailscale hostname, on a tailnet no
phone was ever a member of, with no server behind it. Every incident queued on
the device to its hundred-item cap and was then dropped.

Nothing about the reporting changed here, because nothing about it was wrong.
It now has an address that exists.

### Features

- Diagnostics are sent to diagnostics.pnsjy.in, which is a real relay reached
  through the same tunnel as everything else. Consent and content are unchanged:
  allow-listed technical failures only, never reminder text, location, files or
  account state.

### Bug fixes

- The relay address pointed at a tailnet host that resolves nowhere. Every
  incident this app has ever recorded was queued and discarded.
- Removed two unused constants naming a Google Sheet that incidents do not go
  to. Nothing read them, and anyone reading the file would reasonably have
  believed otherwise.

### Notes

DIAGNOSTICS_RELAY still overrides the address at build time, so a debug build
can point at a local instance.

### Toolchain

The build was broken before this release and could not produce an APK at all.
build_runner crashed inside the analyzer with "Missing implementation of
visitDotShorthandPropertyAccess". The cause was the Flutter SDK itself: its
services/platform_views.dart declares a parameter default using dot-shorthand
syntax, and the pinned analyzer 7.6.0 has no visitor for that node, so anything
summarising package:flutter/services.dart died.

riverpod_generator was what pinned that analyzer, and this app has zero
@riverpod annotations - it was doing no work and blocking the toolchain.
Removing it and riverpod_annotation freed analyzer to 13.3.0 and drift_dev to
2.34.x. flutter_riverpod stays on 2.6.1, so nothing about how the app builds
state changed.

Deprecated Flutter APIs were migrated as part of getting the build green:
Switch.activeColor to activeThumbColor, and both Radio groups onto RadioGroup
ancestors. The delete-scope dialog had no tests at all despite being the screen
that decides whether one occurrence or a whole repeating reminder is destroyed;
it has five now.

twinclean.notes:
Show the app version and PNSJY branding in Settings

Settings now ends with the current app version and the PNSJY store branding, so every
PNSJY app presents the same footer.

### Features

- The Settings screen now shows the installed app version and a PNSJY brand footer as its
  last two items, consistent across all PNSJY apps.

### Bug fixes

No user-facing bug fixes in this release.

family.notes:
## Bug fixes

- **Fixed the app being told there was no update when there was one.** The list of published versions is cached for ten minutes by the network it comes from, and the app was reading whichever copy it was handed. So for at least ten minutes after a release — and longer if a phone or network held the file — checking for updates confidently reported that the current version was the newest. The app now always asks for a fresh copy.

  An update check that answers wrongly is worse than one that does not run: it stops you looking.

taashclub.notes:
Taash Club 1.9.0 - Gochi

A third game. Four players, thirteen cards each, and a promise you have to keep
without keeping it too well.

### Features

- Gochi khelo. Pehla patta khol ke baanta jaata hai - uska rang hi kaat. Phir
  har koi bolta hai kitne haath banayega, kam se kam do, zyada se zyada aath.
- Score seedha hai: har bole hue haath ke das point, aur uske upar har haath ka
  ek. Kam bane to poore minus. Aur agar theek DOUBLE bana diye - to गोची, wo
  bhi minus.
- बंद: apna round band karo, paanch haath banao aur seedhe sau point. Na bane to
  pachaas minus. Dus round mein do baar, paanch round mein ek baar.
- सुपर: aath bolo aur aath bana lo, match wahin khatam - aap pehle, chahe kisi
  ka bhi score kuch bhi ho.
- Teeno tarah se khel sakte ho, baaki do games ki tarah: computer ke saath,
  dosto ke saath apne apne phone par, ya sab ek hi phone par.

### Bug fixes

- None. This release adds a game and changes nothing about the other two.

### Notes

The table shows how close each player is to exactly doubling their bid - amber
one trick away, red when it lands. That is the whole point of the game's name,
and without it you would only find out when the round was scored.

The cut rule that makes this game its own thing: holding neither the colour led
nor a trump above the trump already played, you are NOT forced to cut. A trump
that cannot win is a trump wasted, so you may throw anything.

Gochi can only ever happen on a bid of two to six. Double a bid of seven is
fourteen tricks and only thirteen exist, so the top two bids carry no gochi
risk at all. That is not a rule, it falls out of the deal.
